name: @isocan/cloudstore
//: The vendor lives here and NOWHERE else. These two libraries are 156 packages and ~43 MiB, and `npm i -g github:dglazkov/isocan#release` resolves the ROOT manifest only — so declaring them here rather than there is what keeps the CLI install at 81 packages for a daemon that runs FileStore. test/packaging.test.ts asserts both halves of that: @google-cloud/* here, and nowhere in the root package.
